newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends firmer vs dlr, mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends firmer vs dlr, mark.

text.p: 1530 GMT - The Swiss franc regained ground after days of sinking against against the dollar to close firmer than the day before. Traders said the change was more likely a temporary consolidation than a correction.
* The dollar closed at 1.4718/4728 Swiss francs vs Monday's close at 1.4794/4799. Dollar/Swiss had opened at 1.4830/40, the highest level since 1.4875 francs the week of December 31, 1993.
* The mark closed at 86.98/87.00 centimes vs opening 87.10/12 and prior close of 87.10/13.

* Traders said dollar/Swiss had hovered in busy two-way trading in the European morning session and then fell after the New York opening produced a large sell order. "But this does not mean the upward trend (in dollar/Swiss) is over," one trader said.
* Dollar/Swiss was seen supported 1.4700 and capped at 1.4850, then 1.4875, after whcih it could ehad for 1.4950.
* Mark/swiss was seen in a trading range of 86.90/87.20.
